content:
name: Docs

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
    paths:
      - 'website/**'
      - 'packages/ui/**'
      - 'packages/api/**'
      - 'packages/*/README.md'
      - 'README.md'
      - '.github/workflows/docs.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'yarn'
          cache-dependency-path: yarn.lock

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --immutable

      - name: Build packages
        run: yarn build

      - name: Build demo
        run: yarn workspace @bull-board/demo build

      - name: Build docs
        run: yarn workspace @bull-board/website docs:build

      - name: Configure Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v5

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: website/doc_build

  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
